notes.title: New Update - v0.1.4
notes.notes:
Grass Simulator has now been updated to 0.1.4! – This update includes some fundamental changes that users have been reporting to us over the past few days.
http://i.imgur.com/qa56NSp.jpg

http://i.imgur.com/wkjQPb3.png

We’ve made some improvements, hopefully solving most of the issues with the menu not exiting properly, and adding and fixing immortal cows – when you shoot a cow now you’ve got to be careful as the explosive methane is lethal to the player!

We’ve also made some improvements to the range area, improving the target physics and adding a new area for the player, we’ve been playing around with physics and water shading so expect more updates in the coming weeks that will address even more concerns that our players have.

We’ve also got a Christmas Update planned in December, so don’t miss the full! – I’ve included the full change-log below for 0.1.4!

http://i.imgur.com/BU4OX9N.png

0.1.4 - new changes 
-added new details on classic mode
-cows can now be shot 
-fixed hit box on cows
-fixed grass simulation exit menu
-added some new content ports for upcoming updates
-added physical targets in range
-added new area in range
-fixed fps in range
-fixed some issues with gui
